scope: Local SQLite synthetic envelope workload, no LLM/token/e2e quality claim

implementation.procedure: Read executed diff and frozen harness; compare old and candidate SQL semantics
implementation.acceptance: Only derived indexes/query planning changes; no changed message contracts

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare exact baseline/candidate inbox data against generated expected seq/event IDs; migration, multi-run, per-recipient ACK, duplicate, concurrent, changed-ref tests

data_integrity.procedure: Verify source hashes, fixture sizes, repetitions, raw samples and command provenance
data_integrity.acceptance: All31 pairs per workload and complete controls; no missing/filtered cases

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute median,p95,VM-step ratios from raw arrays
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Positive finite ns, exact units and matching summaries

measurement_validity.procedure: Check full inbox timing, separate VM instrumentation, alternating order,5 warmups,write overhead and index cost
measurement_validity.acceptance: Complete equivalent paired measurements including controls and overhead; negative results remain usable. Positive adoption thresholds are separately frozen in plan.json.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent representative rerun on isolated output with same frozen script
reproducibility.acceptance: Equivalent outputs; consistent rerun direction and magnitude with noise and any disagreement disclosed; no positive benefit required for a usable negative result.
